protocol_section_3_4.text:
### 3.4 Temperature Decisive Metrics & Falsification Thresholds
Evaluated on out-of-sample validation series across N_decisive = 3 decisive metrics, subject to an absolute physical consistency disqualifying gate:

| Metric | Definition | Threshold / Tolerance | Rationale |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **|Bias_m|** | Maximum absolute monthly bias across all calendar months (m=1..12): max(max_m |Bias_m(T_max)|, max_m |Bias_m(T_min)|) | <= 0.5 °C | Prevents seasonal phase distortion in degree-day and phenological models. |
| **DTR Bias** | Diurnal Temperature Range (T_max - T_min): absolute value of the mean DTR bias, |mean(DTR_mod - DTR_obs)| (not a daily MAE) | |Delta DTR| <= 0.8 °C | Captures boundary-layer thermal inertia and radiative damping. |
| **Extreme Percentiles** | Maximum extreme percentile bias: max(|Delta P_5(T_min)|, |Delta P_95(T_max)|) | <= 0.8 °C | Evaluates thermal stress risks, frost exposure, and microclimatic extremes. |

#### Aggregation of Extreme Components
Pairwise extremes are aggregated taking the maximum absolute value. Both individual components (e.g., P_5 of T_min and P_95 of T_max) and their respective 95% annual bootstrap confidence intervals must satisfy the <= 0.8 °C threshold for the metric to achieve Pass.

protocol_section_5_1.text:
### 5.1 Annual Block Bootstrap Uncertainty
All metric biases and paired error differences are evaluated using a **1,000-replica block bootstrap with a fixed block length of 1 year (annual blocks)**:
- Resampling whole 1-year blocks preserves interannual climate variability (such as ENSO regimes) and prevents the artificial disruption or mixing of seasonal cycles.
- **Paired Bootstrap for Method Differences**: All paired error differences Delta Error = |Error_{k-1}| - |Error_k| and Delta |PBIAS| = |PBIAS_raw| - |PBIAS_corr| are computed via **paired annual block bootstrap**: in each of the 1,000 bootstrap iterations, the exact same resampled calendar years are evaluated for both candidate method and baseline.
- The 30-day block bootstrap is strictly reserved for daily lag analysis (temporal alignment).

protocol_appendix_j_7.text:
### J.7 Valid Years and Minimum Sample
1. A calendar year is valid if it contains at least one paired day with all four values valid (Sections D.16 and E.6.9).
2. A track is computed only if its evaluation series contains at least `MIN_BOOTSTRAP_BLOCKS = 7` valid years. Otherwise the station-variable-track is reported as **Not Established (insufficient sample)**; under Section 5.4 no level can then reach Global Success at that station.

protocol_appendix_j_8.text:
### J.8 Levels, Metrics and Outcomes
Levels 0, 1, 2, Level 3 winner and Level 3 constant (Sections 6.2 and E.7). For each: decisive metrics with 95 % intervals (Section 3.4; 1,000 replicas, annual blocks, seed 42), physical consistency gate and crossing diagnostics (Section 3.5), three-tier outcomes (Section 5.2), state mapping (Section 5.3), concordance (Section 4.3), progression diagnostics with paired bootstrap (Section 6.4), and operational designation across both stations (Section 5.4).
